text: The Meridian planning document (3–10 Nov) sets final timeout, TTL, worker, and queue values for about fifteen services, including checkout, tenant, pricing, backup, indexer, shipping, and billing. Hard rules prohibit dependency paths from reports to notify, quota to gateway, and archive to sync. The indexer may not depend on auth, even indirectly. The indexer and shipping must use separate workers, and alerts and archive may never share one. Ownership is divided: alpha owns tenant and indexer, gamma owns search and webhooks, delta owns profile, reports, and notify, and beta owns billing. Rollout order is gateway before cache, audit before sync, alerts before webhooks, and billing before tenant. One issue remains unresolved: billing and media must share a worker, but audit keeps backup and media apart.
